newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Metroplex in Philippines casino venture.
newsitem.headline: Metroplex in Philippines casino venture.

text.p: Malaysia's Metroplex Bhd said on Tuesday that it has entered into an agreement with Philippines-based Belle Group to jointly undertake the construction and development of a casino and hotel at Belle Bay Plaza in Manila, Philippines.

In a statement, Metroplex said the casino would be a Las Vegas-style 15,000 sq metre facility. Metroplex, whose stock was suspended in Kuala Lumpur on Monday for an announcement, is involved in housing and property development.
Metroplex will invest in 40 percent of the equity of the joint-venture corporation, with Belle and its affiliates assuming the balance.

Investment costs will be about $100 million and the project is expected to be completed by the end of 1998. Metroplex said its contribution was expected to be financed partly through internally-generated funds and partly through borrowings.
The project will help Metroplex become a bigger regional player in the leisure and tourism industry, the statement said.

Metroplex said that Belle and the Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corp had also signed an agreement under which Belle is to lease the casino in Belle Bay Plaza to the gaming concern for its operation.
The gaming concern is a Philippines government entity which has exclusive rights to operate and maintain casinos in the country.
Metroplex said that the casino and hotel, which is to be built on 4.6 hectares, will be the largest in the world.
It will replace one of three existing casinos in Manila, it said.
Belle Bay Plaza will take up 19 hectares on Manila Bay.
